name: The Trailer
_note: A memory flashback (owner ruling 2026-09-26): the travel trailer of February 2020 to summer 2021, as a fictional interior bound to no place. No address, no street, no coordinates, ever. Quest one plays here.

interactables.label: The warm spot
text: A rug by the little heater. Somebody is always on it.

interactables.label: The bed
text: The people's bed. Also, at night, everyone's bed.

interactables.label: Shelf
text: Cans, a camera bag, a flute case.
